capabilities: Sync clipped Get notes into the vault
Store Getbiji API credentials in settings
Trigger sync from a ribbon icon or the command palette
extras: Sync is started manually from the ribbon or command palette; credentials must be obtained from the Getbiji Open Platform first.
problem: Notes and clips collected in Get stay on the service and are not available as local Markdown files in the vault.

relations.evidence: sync the notes you've clipped on the Get mobile app, web version, and various browser extensions

requires.name: Getbiji Open Platform Client ID and API Key

summary: Plugin that syncs notes clipped in the Get mobile app, web version and browser extensions into an Obsidian vault through the Getbiji Open API.
